local_dependency_review_notes: The USDZ custom metadata and source page both state CC BY 4.0. Eight embedded 2K maps carry no separate stated terms; D1 binds its four maps. The selected USDC resolves the original USDZ as a local dependency; both original and normalized release snapshot are retained.
local_duplicate_review_notes: D1 fingerprint c87dd0edf71d37796a5865f7785ea44b2581f0dadb4110b73ec24016b2e75b3d differs from all 18 accepted geometries. D2 leaf points/faces are identical; D2 frame differs by at most 0.72 micrometers in points with identical faces, and only material/texture binding changes. D2 is excluded as a geometry duplicate.
local_asset_shape_review_notes: D1 is one full-size single-leaf interior door with a modeled matching frame, separate leaf, two handles, visible upper/lower hinges and fixed strike plate. The preview display meshes and D2 are excluded.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Attempt 000016 passes static and one isolated RTX 4090 run to 54.2 degrees with three exact resets, zero frame drift and zero reported penetration. Bounded 1.3% Panel/Handle fit, frame profile partitions and reviewed local hinge contact-pair filters retain leaf/frame/handle collision. Robot/expert qualification is pending.
local_visual_review_notes: Actually viewed front and rear RTX images in attempt 000016: complete dark wood slab/frame, paired lever handles and rear upper/lower hinges; material resolves and no missing or grossly misaligned parts. A small top reveal from the 1.3% fit remains visible.
